v: strI apa + vAraRe DA--BAve striyAm aN । vAraRArTaM niroDe, “gA udAjadapaDA balasya” iti f॰ 2, 12, 3 । “apaDAapaDAyAH niroDAditi” BA॰ ।
m: 1. अप-√ धा (Imper. -दधातु; aor. Pass. -धायि) to take off, place aside, RV. iv, 28, 2; vi, 20, 5 and x, 164, 3.
2. अप-धा f. hiding, shutting up, RV. ii, 12, 3.
a: अपधा — Ved. Shutting up, hiding (वारणार्थं निरोधः).

m: अप-√ धाव् to run away, AV.; ŚBr., to depart (from a previous statement), prevaricate, Mn. viii, 54.
अप-√ धू (1. sg. -धूनोमि) to shake off, ŚāṅkhGṛ.
अप-धूम mfn. free from smoke, Ragh.
a: अपधूम — a. Free from smoke; ˚त्व R. 10. 74.

m: अप-√ धम् (3. pl. -धमन्ति impf. अपाधमत् 2. sg. -अधमस्) to blow away or off, RV.
अप-√ धृष् -धृष् णोति, to overcome, subdue, KauṣBr. (cf. अन्-अपधृष्य.)
अप-धुरम् away from the yoke, TBr.

a: अपध्वांत — a. Sounding wrongly. --तं A wrong or harsh sound.

v: na॰ apakfzwaM DvAntaM Dvanitam Dvana--kta vede ni॰ svanArTe'pi iqaBAvaH । BinnakAMsyasvarasame Sabde “vfhaspaterapaDvAntamiti” CA॰ upa॰ । vArhaspatyaM tadapaDvAnta BinnakAMsyasvarasamamiti” BA॰ ।
m: अप-ध्वान्त mfn. (√ ध्वन्), sounding wrong, ChUp.
अप-√ ध्वंस् -ध्वंसति, to scold, revile, [Comm. on] MBh. i, 5596 (‘to drive or turn away’, NBD.); to fall away, be degraded (NBD.), Hariv. 720.
a: अपध्वंस् — {c1c} A. (rarely P.) 1 To pack off, clear out; अपध्वंसेति बहुशो वदन् क्रोधसमन्वितः Hariv. --2 To abuse, revile, scold; न चाप्यन्यमपध्वंसेत्कदाचित्कोपसंयुतः Mb. --Caus. To free from dust; blow away (as dust &c.).

v: pu॰ apa + Dvansa--BAve GaY । nASe, yasya yaTArUpamucitaM tataH pracyave ca । “paTAmapaDvaMsenEtvindra” iti aTa॰ 1, 3, 5 ।
m: अप-ध्वंस m. concealment, AV.
‘falling away, degradation’, in comp. with
a: अपध्वंसः — 1 Degradation, falling off or from, disgrace. --2 Concealment. --Comp. --जः, --जा a person of a mixed, degraded and impure caste (where the mother belongs to a higher caste than the father's) Ms. 10. 41, 46.

s: puM, (apaDvasyate'nena, apaDvansa + karaRe GaY, apaDvaMso jAtInAM BinnatAsampAdakaH saNkarastasmAjjAyate, apaDvaMsa + jan + qa, upapadasamAsaH .) varRasaNkaraH । yaTA, -- “SUdrARAntu saDarmmARaH sarvve'paDvaMsajAH smftAH” । iti manuH । (pratilomajAtaH । BinnavarRasaNgamajAtaH । karaRAdisaMkIrRavarRaH .)
v: puMstrI apaDvasyate'nena apaDvaMsaH varRAnAM BinnarUpatAsaMmAdakaH saNkarastasmAjjAyate jana--qa 5 ta॰ । BinnavarRasaNgamajAte karaRAdO saNkIrRavarRe । “SUdrARAM tu saDarmmARaH sarvve'paDvaMsajAH smftA” iti manuH “ye dvijAnAmapasadA ye cApaDvaMsajAH smftA” iti ca manuH । tezAM pitrIH samavarRatvAprApteH svarUpapracyavena jAtatvAt taTAtvam ।
m: अप-ध्वंस—ज mfn. ‘born from it’, a child of a mixed or impure caste (whose father belongs to a lower [Mn. x, 41, 46] or higher [MBh. xiii, 2617] caste than its mother's).

v: tri॰ apaDvaMsayati apa + Dvansa--Ric--Rini । nASake । “sarvvEnasAmapaDvaMsi japyaM syAdaDamarzaRamiti” manuH
m: अप-ध्वंसिन् mfn. causing to fall, destroying, abolishing.
a: अपध्वंसिन् — a. Destroying, removing; अर्वैनसामपध्वंसि जप्यं त्रिष्वघमर्षणं Ak.

s: tri, (apa + Dvansa + ktaH .) parityaktaH । ninditaH । cUrRIkftaH । iti medinI । (atidurAcAraH .) parityaktaH । “apaDvastaH parityakte nindite 'pyavacUrRite” । iti medinI ।
v: tri॰ apa + Dvansa--kta । nindite, parityakte avacUrRite ca ।
m: अप-ध्वस्त mfn. degraded
reviled
abandoned, destroyed
अप-ध्वस्त m. a vile wretch lost to all sense of right, L.
a: अपध्वस्त — p. p. 1 Reviled, cursed, accursed, contemptible, to be disdained. --2 Pounded badly or imperfectly (अवचूर्णित). --3 Abandoned. --स्तः A vile wretch, lost to all sense of right and virtue; मूर्ख अपध्वस्तोसि Mk. 8.

k.v: तूष्णींशीलस्तु तूष्णीको नग्नोऽवासा दिगम्बरे। निष्कासितोऽवकृष्टः स्यादपध्वस्तस्तु धिक्कृतः॥

v: na॰ apakfzwaM DyAnam prA॰ sa॰ । anizwacintane । vEparotyacintane ca ।
m: अप-ध्यान n. envy, jealousy, MBh. &c.
meditation upon things which are not to be thought of Jain.
a: अपध्यानं — Evil thoughts, thinking ill of, cursing mentally; तदपध्यानात् पिशाचतामुपगतं K. 29.

m: अप-√ ध्यै to have a bad opinion of, curse mentally, MBh. &c.
a: अपध्यै — {c1c} P. To think ill of, have evil thoughts about, curse mentally; अपध्याता च विप्रेण न्यपतद्धरणतिले Mb.
